ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within circle $O$, chord $AB=4$, point $C$ moves along $AB$. Connect $OC$, and draw $CD\perp OC$ intersecting circle $O$ at point $D$. What is the maximum value of $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, connect $OD$,\\
since $CD \perp OC$,\\
it follows that $\angle DCO = 90^\circ$,\\
thus $CD = \sqrt{OD^{2} - OC^{2}} = \sqrt{r^{2} - OC^{2}}$,\\
when the value of $OC$ is minimal, the value of $CD$ is maximal,\\
$OC \perp AB$ when $OC$ is minimal, at this time points $D$ and $B$ coincide,\\
thus $CD = CB = \frac{1}{2}AB = 2$,\\
that is, the maximal value of $CD$ is $\boxed{2}$,

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: a circle with center O, chord AB drawn slanting across the circle, C located on AB, segment OC drawn, and segment CD drawn from C to the circle with a right-angle mark showing CD ⟂ OC. Read from the text that AB=4 and C can move anywhere along chord AB. Draw OD. Since D is on the circle, OD is the radius r. Triangle OCD is right at C, so CD^2=OD^2-OC^2=r^2-OC^2. Thus maximizing CD is equivalent to minimizing OC as C moves along the fixed chord AB. The nearest point on a line/chord to O is the perpendicular foot from O to AB, which is the midpoint of chord AB. At that position, the perpendicular through C to OC is exactly the chord AB, so D coincides with one endpoint B (or A depending on side). Therefore CD equals half of AB, namely 2.

推理：连接 OD。因为 D 在圆上，所以 OD 是圆的半径，记为 r。又因为 CD ⟂ OC，所以三角形 OCD 在 C 处为直角三角形，得到 CD^2 = OD^2 - OC^2 = r^2 - OC^2。因此要使 CD 最大，就要使 OC 最小。当 C 在固定弦 AB 上移动时，O 到 AB 的最短距离出现在垂足处，即 OC ⟂ AB；圆心到弦的垂线平分弦，所以此时 C 是 AB 的中点。此时过 C 且垂直于 OC 的直线就是弦 AB，D 与弦端点 B（或另一侧为 A）重合，因此 CD 等于半弦长：CD = AB/2 = 4/2 = 2。

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: AB is a chord of circle O, C is a variable point on AB, OC is drawn, and the line through C perpendicular to OC meets the circle at D. From the text, AB=4. Use the chord-midpoint theorem in reverse: for any position of C, the line through C perpendicular to OC is a chord line of the circle, and since the perpendicular from the center O to that chord line meets it at C, C is the midpoint of the full chord cut by this line. Hence CD is half the length of that chord. A chord of a fixed circle is longer when its distance from the center is smaller, so CD is maximized when the chord line through C is closest to O, equivalently when OC is as small as possible. As C ranges over chord AB, the closest point to O is the midpoint M of AB. At C=M, the perpendicular to OM is the original chord AB, so the full chord through C is AB itself and its half-length is AB/2=2. Therefore the maximum CD is 2.

推理：按照图示和题意，过 C 且垂直于 OC 的直线与圆相交形成一条弦，其中一端为 D。因为圆心 O 到这条弦所在直线的垂线正好是 OC，垂足是 C，所以由“圆心到弦的垂线平分弦”可知，C 是这条完整弦的中点，因此 CD 是该弦长的一半。固定圆中，弦离圆心越近，弦长越大；所以要使 CD 最大，就要使 OC 最小。点 C 在弦 AB 上运动时，O 到 AB 的最短距离出现在垂足，也就是 AB 的中点 M。此时过 M 且垂直于 OM 的弦就是原来的 AB，因此对应半弦长为 AB/2=4/2=2。所以 CD 的最大值为 2。

Image description: The figure shows a circle with O as the center; an oblique chord AB passes through the inside of the circle, and C is on chord AB; OC is connected; from C, a line segment CD is drawn to D on the circumference, and there is a right-angle mark in the figure indicating that CD ⟂ OC. The problem gives AB=4, and C can move on AB.
Reasoning: Connect OD. Because D is on the circle, OD is the radius of the circle, denoted as r. Also because CD ⟂ OC, triangle OCD is a right triangle at C, giving CD^2 = OD^2 - OC^2 = r^2 - OC^2. Therefore, to make CD maximum, OC must be made minimum. When C moves on the fixed chord AB, the shortest distance from O to AB occurs at the foot of the perpendicular, that is, OC ⟂ AB; the perpendicular from the center of the circle to a chord bisects the chord, so at this time C is the midpoint of AB. At this time, the line passing through C and perpendicular to OC is chord AB, and D coincides with the chord endpoint B (or with A on the other side), so CD equals the half-chord length: CD = AB/2 = 4/2 = 2.
